summary: Unsigned Carmody Road kerb backing onto bushland, with cars parked on it in 2022.
reasons: Houses 21 m+ away across the road

drivers.seclusion: Bushland directly behind the kerb; nearest dwelling 21 m away across the road, the rest 32 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Road-edge dirt strip and parked cars in the 2022 image show space beside the lane; the section is only 10 m, about one van length.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moderate traffic; the junction is just to the east.
drivers.convention: No parking signs mapped; three cars sit along this side in the 2022 image.

flags: Section is only about 10 m long
Esri 2025 shows no cars parked, only QLD 2022
Traffic noise from a through road
sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy overhead from the south, with shade through the afternoon from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the 10 m fits a van with the kerb edge so close to the junction

best_section.where: south side of Carmody Road, just west of the side-street junction, opposite the corner house
